text:
Alisha Ramos: Day 2 quick check-in:
- Done: walkthrough with mentor, cloned the mono-repo, spun up the sample inference service locally. Created draft PR for the hello-model example.
- Blocker: gitpod workspace won't accept my SSH key. When I try `ssh-add -l` I get: 
```
Could not open a connection to your authentication agent.
```
Also the Remote - SSH extension fails to install in the workspace (permissions error). Using macOS Ventura, Homebrew OpenSSH, and a YubiKey for SSH certs. Anyone hit this?

Tarun Iyer: Hmm — familiar. Two quick things to try: 1) make sure an agent is running: `eval "$(ssh-agent -s)"` then `ssh-add --apple-use-keychain ~/.ssh/id_ed25519` (if using the mac keychain). 2) check `~/.ssh/config` for `UseKeychain yes` and `AddKeysToAgent yes`. If the YubiKey is doing certs, sometimes you need `ssh-add -s /usr/local/lib/ykcs11.dylib` (path varies).

Jared (IT): @Alisha can you paste the output of `ssh -vT git@github.com` and `ls -la ~/.ssh` (sanitized) so we can see perms? Also confirm whether the YubiKey prompts light up when you touch it. If it's a workspace permission issue, we might need to flip a container setting in gitpod that blocks native agent forwarding.

Alisha Ramos: Pasted outputs — small snippet: 
```
OpenSSH_9.1p1, LibreSSL 2.8.3
debug1: Reading configuration data /Users/alisha/.ssh/config
debug1: Connecting to github.com [140.82.114.4] port 22.
debug1: identity file /Users/alisha/.ssh/id_ed25519 type 0
debug1: agent refused operation
Permission denied (publickey).
```
Also `ls -la ~/.ssh` shows my keys with 600 perms. YubiKey does flash when touched.

onboard-bot: If you haven't yet, see the onboarding doc: https://intranet.redwood/handbook/onboarding/dev-ssh-gitpod — it has the gitpod container workaround (enable agent forwarding under workspace settings).

Sasha R.: If it's urgent for making the PR, you can push up a branch without SSH: `git remote set-url origin https://github.com/org/repo.git` then `git push` — not ideal, but unblocks the review. Happy to review the PR once it's up.

Tarun Iyer: Another mac-specific tip: newer OpenSSH on mac uses `--apple-use-keychain`. Try: `eval "$(ssh-agent -s)" && ssh-add --apple-use-keychain ~/.ssh/id_ed25519` and then `ssh -T git@github.com` again. If agent still refuses, try `ssh-add -K ~/.ssh/id_ed25519` (older macs) or `ssh-add -s /usr/local/lib/ykcs11.dylib` if using PIV applet.

Jared (IT): If those fail, I can remote into your workstation via Jumpbox for 10–15 min. Ping me with a time and I'll schedule. Also filing a ticket to check the gitpod agent-forwarding policy for your workspace id `gp-3241`.

Alisha Ramos: Followed Tarun's `--apple-use-keychain` command and now `ssh -T git@github.com` returns: `Hi alisha! You've successfully authenticated, but GitHub does not provide shell access.` Woohoo — agent working and PR pushed. Thanks everyone! :tada:

Sasha R.: Nice — I'll take a look at the draft PR this afternoon. Welcome aboard again! :rocket:
